newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - S&P lowers BTR Nylex to A-Plus/A-1.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - S&P lowers BTR Nylex to A-Plus/A-1.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it has lowered BTR Nylex Ltd's long term credit rating to A-plus from AA-minus and the commercial paper rating to A-1 from A-1 plus.
Standard and Poor's said the ratings action reflected the ratings downgrade of the commercial paper rating of BTR Nylex's parent company, the UK-based BTR Plc, to A-1 from A-1 plus.

The ratings agency said that while BTR Plc did not guarantee BTR Nylex's obligations, its credit standing was identical to those of the parent company, based on BTR Nylex's strategic importance and economic significance.
